Benchmark results

In one Inspect AI run on 13 authored synthetic cases, we graded whether the judge recognized the intended behavior and selected supporting words.

10/13
Targets with all assessed labels correct
3/6
Matched families with every label correct

The judge misread explicitly framed fiction as a personal claim, flagged an offer to resume later as retention, and missed an explicit transfer of decision authority.

These development cases show where the judge succeeds and fails on particular examples. Reliability in everyday chats and effects on people remain open questions.
